name: South Face
overview: A friendly two-pitch alpine rock route on solid granite offering excellent views and moderate technical climbing with good protection opportunities.
beta: Two-pitch technical rock climb on solid granite. The South Face receives consistent sun, making it a good choice early and late in the season. Approach via Burgundy Col from Highway 20. Descent via North Ridge scramble or rappel.
descent_text: From the summit, climbers typically descend via the North Ridge, a fun and easy Class 3 scramble back to Burgundy Col. The North Ridge descent takes approximately 1 hour round trip from summit to col. Alternatively, rappel stations may be used for a faster descent.
descent: Down climb the North Ridge to return to Burgundy Col or rappel from the summit.
rappels: Rappel stations equipped; a 70m rope reaches each station, a 60m rope suffices with easy down-climbing between stations

pitch_detail.notes: Face climbing on solid granite with good protection features. Pleasant climbing to sandy bench. Establish belay at ledge.
Slab climbing from bench to summit. Good cracks on left side with finger-sized features. Final moves lead to rocky summit.
